newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens stocks end up, resistance seen at 1,100pts.
newsitem.headline: Athens stocks end up, resistance seen at 1,100pts.

text.p: Greek stocks closed 2.53 percent higher in heavy volume with market watchers expecting the market momentum to last and placing the resistance level at 1,100 points.

"On Wednesday the bourse's performance was exceptional. The market trend is definitely upward and I expect it to last. We have no major corrections and I see a resistance share index level at 1,100 points,", said Apostolos Constantinides, a broker at Hambros Hellenic Securities.
Main investment interest was concentrated on blue chips and large capitalization stocks, he added.

"The Greek market has rallied since the beginning of 1997. Investors for whom stocks were only a small percentage of their portfolios, are on a day-to-day basis redirecting their funds into shares of all sectors," he said.
Wednesday's volume of 13.1 billion drachmas was heavy, added Constandinides.
News of a 40 percent rise of EU investment in the Greek industrial sector will drive the market up, he said.

"Trading volume was high on Wednesday and we expect it to rise more. However, a correction is both desirable and expected. Today, we saw a correction during the session," said Pavlos Lekos, a broker at Atlas Securities.
Greek investors from other parts of the country who previously abstained were slowly being attracted to the bourse, he said.
The Athens general share index jumped 2.53 percent or 26.38 points at 1070.01 from Tuesday's 1043.63, after opening at 1042.46.

Banks rose 3.37 percent, construction gained 1.84 percent while small caps rose 2.57 percent. Industrials closed 1.80 percent higher while investment shares rose by 3.13 percent and insurance stocks gained 3.19 percent.
Wednesday's turnover was 13.1 billion drachmas on volume of 5.4 million shares. Gainers led losers 173 to 54 with 24 issues unchanged on 251 traded.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 872.00-890.00. Shares of OTE telecom the underlying, rose 130 drachmas to 5,265.

The recently launched ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted higher at $14.30-$15.30. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted higher at 6,062-6,447 drachmas. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
